questions.question: If x = 1 is a root of x³ − 2x² − 5x + 6 = 0, find the other roots.
questions.explanation: Dividing by x − 1 gives x² − x − 6 = (x − 3)(x + 2). Thus the polynomial is (x − 1)(x − 3)(x + 2). Apart from x = 1, the roots are 3 and −2: option C.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: y varies partly as the square of x and partly as the inverse of the square root of x. Find the expression for y if y = 2 when x = 1 and y = 6 when x = 4.
questions.explanation: Write y = ax² + b/√x. The first condition gives a + b = 2. The second gives 16a + b/2 = 6, or 32a + b = 12. Subtracting gives 31a = 10, so a = 10/31 and b = 52/31. Therefore y = 10x²/31 + 52/(31√x), option A. Substitution gives 2 at x = 1 and 6 at x = 4.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Simplify [(x − 7)/(x² − 9)] × [(x² − 3x)/(x² − 49)].

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If w varies inversely as V and u varies directly as w³, find the relationship between u and V, given that u = 1 when V = 2.

questions.question: Solve the simultaneous equations for x x² + y – 8 = 0 y + 5x – 2 = 0

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the sector angles, in order, for a pie chart representing the values 6, 10, 14, 16 and 26.

questions.question: The letters of the word MATRICULATION are cut and put into a box. One of the letter is drawn at random from the box. Find the probability of drawing a vowel.

questions.question: If (2/3)^m × (3/4)^n = 256/729, find m and n.

questions.question: If the price of each orange were raised by ½ kobo, a customer spending ₦2.40 would be able to buy 16 fewer oranges. What is the price of an orange before the increase?

questions.question: Bola chooses an integer at random from 1 through 300 inclusive, with each integer equally likely. What is the probability that it is divisible by 4?

questions.question: Without logarithm tables, evaluate (log base 3 of 27 − log base 1/4 of 64) / (log base 3 of 1/81).

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: In a racing competition, Musa covered 5x km in the first hour and (x + 10) km in the next hour. He finished behind Ngozi, who covered 118 km in those two hours. Which inequality describes the possible positive values of x?
questions.explanation: Musa’s total distance is 5x + (x + 10) = 6x + 10 km. Because it is less than 118 km, 6x + 10 < 118, giving x < 18. His first-hour distance is positive, so x > 0. Together, 0 < x < 18, option E.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Tunde and Shola can finish a piece of work together in 18 days. Tunde can do it alone in x days, while Shola would take 15 days longer. Which equation is satisfied by x?
questions.explanation: Their daily work rates are 1/x and 1/(x + 15). Together, 1/x + 1/(x + 15) = 1/18. Multiplying by 18x(x + 15) gives 18(2x + 15) = x(x + 15), hence x² − 21x − 270 = 0, option C. Its positive solution is x = 30; working with Shola’s 45-day rate gives 1/30 + 1/45 = 1/18.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Which quadratic equation has roots 1 − √13 and 1 + √13?
questions.explanation: The roots add to 2. Their product is (1 − √13)(1 + √13) = 1 − 13 = −12. A monic quadratic with these roots is x² − (sum)x + product = 0, so x² − 2x − 12 = 0, option E.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: A triangle has sides (x + 4) cm, x cm and (x − 4) cm. If the cosine of its largest angle is 1/5, find x.

questions.question: Find the integer values of x satisfying −3 < 2 − 5x < 12.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Two independent fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that both show the same number?

questions.question: Water is said to be ‘hard’ if it

options.B: must be warmed before sodium chloride dissolves
options.C: forms an insoluble scum with soap

questions.ai_explanation: Calcium and magnesium ions in hard water react with soap ions to form insoluble salts, seen as scum. This also makes it harder to obtain a lather.

questions.question: An aqueous metal salt M gives a white precipitate with NaOH, soluble in excess NaOH. It also gives a white precipitate with aqueous ammonia, soluble in excess ammonia. What is the cation in M?
questions.ai_explanation: Zinc ions form white Zn(OH)₂ with either reagent. The precipitate dissolves in excess NaOH because it is amphoteric, and in excess ammonia because zinc forms a soluble ammine complex. These two observations identify Zn²⁺.

questions.question: What is the IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃?
questions.ai_explanation: The longest continuous carbon chain has four carbon atoms, so the parent is butane. Numbering from the nearer end puts the methyl branch on carbon 2, giving 2-methylbutane.
